  <div class="config-fields">
    
<div class="ze-field" id="field-router-id">
  <label class="ze-field-label">router-id
    <span class="ze-field-info" data-tooltip="BGP Router ID (required). RFC 6286 Section 2.1 defines the BGP
Identifier as a 4-octet, unsigned, NON-ZERO integer, so 0.0.0.0
is rejected: a peer implementing RFC 6286 Section 2.2 answers an
OPEN carrying it with Bad BGP Identifier.">i</span>
  </label>

<input type="text" class="ze-field-input ze-field-set" name="value" value="1.2.3.4"
       hx-post="/config/set/bgp" hx-trigger="blur changed, keyup[key=='Enter'], input changed delay:1s" hx-target="closest .ze-field" hx-swap="outerHTML"
       hx-vals='{"leaf":"router-id"}' pattern="^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$"><span class="ze-field-tag ze-field-tag-set">set</span>

</div>
